_comment: FROZEN naive-momentum baseline config (C-4, T-311). DO NOT EDIT after the first model fit.
This is the GATE-B control: the snipe model must beat THIS, net of cost, on recorded data
(EDGE-VERDICT.md GATE-B / Â§5 K-1). The params below are CHANGE-CONTROLLED: a test FAILS
(baseline_changed_after_fit) if the canonical hash of `params` changes after first fit.
The hash is stored in `frozen_hash` and is recomputed deterministically from `params` alone.
The baseline rule (data-models.md Â§3.2): 'enter every candidate with positive first-K-slot
net buy pressure above a fixed percentile.' It is constructible from first_k_buy_pressure +
first_k_volume_lamports ONLY (no future data, point-in-time). It carries NO selection
intelligence beyond this fixed rule (walk-forward Â§4). It emits a SELECTION SIGNAL + a momentum
score and a baseline probability proxy â€” NEVER a price, NEVER a trade decision, NEVER a size.

params_provenance.first_k_slots: K â€” width of the point-in-time buy-pressure window in slots (matches FeatureFrame.first_k_slots).
params_provenance.selection_percentile: Fixed percentile of the FROZEN reference net-buy-pressure distribution; a candidate is selected iff its net buy pressure >= the reference threshold at this percentile. Frozen so it is NOT chosen post-hoc (red-team 2A p-hacking guard).
params_provenance.unit_of_risk: GATE-B unit â€” net PnL per SOL at risk. The model's net-PnL-per-unit-risk must beat the baseline's on the SAME windows/cost-stack (EDGE-VERDICT GATE-B).
params_provenance.candidate_universe: The frozen candidate set the baseline ranks over; identical to the universe the model sees (only selection intelligence is denied the baseline).
params_provenance.feature_schema_version: Hashed in (data-models.md Â§3 note): if the feature set changes after freeze, this version bumps and the immutability test FAILS.
params_provenance.min_volume_lamports: Minimum first-K traded volume (lamports, integer) for a candidate to be eligible; 0 = no volume floor. Money is integer lamports, never float.
params_provenance.reference_threshold_lamports: The FROZEN net-buy-pressure threshold (lamports, Decimal-as-string) that the `selection_percentile` resolves to on the reference cohort. Stored explicitly so the rule is reproducible without re-reading any data. Decimal-as-string, never float.
